title: IDW Comics Inserts: card flavor text

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A thief and Planeswalker who is hunted across planes and seeks Sifa Grent.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: A character who takes youth from others and whom Dack Fayden seeks.

entities.name: Maytov
entities.description: A character who warns Dack that all of Ravnica is looking for him.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A draconic demon that looms over Dack and has encountered other Planeswalkers.

entities.name: Ancient Fang
entities.description: An artifact imbued with spells darker than any Dack Fayden would cast.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose people are looking for Dack.

entities.name: Wojek
entities.description: A force on Ravnica that is searching for Dack.

events.summary: Dack Fayden is confronted by the draconic demon Malfegor and senses it has met other Planeswalkers.
events.quote: The draconic demon loomed over Dack

events.summary: Dack Fayden tries to escape a giant's sphere of magic in order to find Sifa.
events.quote: only that he had to escape it to find Sifa.

relations.note: All of Ravnica, from the Wojek on down, is looking for Dack.
relations.quote: "All of Ravnica's looking for you, Dack, from the Wojek on down."
only that he had to escape it to find Sifa.
